LESSON: THE EARLY CHURCH

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 4.1: The Early Church

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Early Church. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in The Early Church
2. Practise The Early Church at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Early Church

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in The Early Church
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in The Early Church. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise The Early Church at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise The Early Church at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Early Church
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to The Early Church. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Early Church using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Early Church in the examples.
2. Explain The Early Church to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Early Church.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Early Church using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Early Church important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in The Early Church
2. Practise The Early Church at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to The Early Church

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
